160. function LayerColorPickerContent({
161.   currentColor,
162.   currentOpacity,
163.   usedColors,
164.   onConfirm,
165.   onOpacityChange,
166. }: {
167.   currentColor: string;
168.   currentOpacity: number;
169.   usedColors?: string[];
170.   onConfirm: (hex: string) => void;
171.   onOpacityChange?: (opacity: number) => void;
172. }) {
173.   const [pending, setPending] = useState(currentColor);
174.   const [pickerKey, setPickerKey] = useState(0);
175.   const [opacity, setOpacity] = useState(currentOpacity);
176. 
177.   const usedSet = useMemo(
178.     () => new Set((usedColors ?? []).map((c) => c.toLowerCase())),
179.     [usedColors]
180.   );
181. 
182.   return (
183.     <div className="w-60 space-y-3">
184.       {/* Live preview */}
185.       <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
186.         <div
187.           className="h-7 w-7 rounded border border-border shadow-sm shrink-0"
188.           style={{ backgroundColor: pending, opacity: opacity / 100 }}
189.         />
190.         <span className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
191.           {pending.toUpperCase()}
192.         </span>
193.       </div>
194. 
195.       {/* Preset swatches — unused colors first, used colors dimmed */}
196.       <div>
197.         <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mb-1">
198.           Palette (● = bereits verwendet)
199.         </div>
200.         <div className="grid grid-cols-8 gap-1">
201.           {DEFAULT_LAYER_COLORS.map((c) => {
202.             const isUsed = usedSet.has(c.toLowerCase());
203.             return (
204.               <button
205.                 key={c}
206.                 type="button"
207.                 title={isUsed ? `${c} (in Benutzung)` : c}
208.                 className={`h-6 w-6 rounded border-2 transition-transform hover:scale-110 relative ${isUsed ? "opacity-40" : "ring-0"}`}
209.                 style={{
210.                   backgroundColor: c,
211.                   borderColor:
212.                     pending.toLowerCase() === c.toLowerCase()
213.                       ? "currentColor"
214.                       : "transparent",
215.                 }}
216.                 onClick={() => {
217.                   setPending(c);
218.                   setPickerKey((k) => k + 1);
219.                   onConfirm(c);
220.                 }}
221.               >
222.                 {isUsed && (
223.                   <span className="absolute -top-0.5 -right-0.5 w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-foreground/50 text-[6px] flex items-center justify-center text-background leading-none">
224.                     ●
225.                   </span>
226.                 )}
227.               </button>
228.             );
229.           })}
230.         </div>
231.       </div>
232. 
233.       {/* Full color picker */}
234.       <ColorPicker
235.         key={pickerKey}
236.         defaultValue={pending}
237.         onChange={(value) => {
238.           const [r, g, b] = value as number[];
239.           const hex = `#${[r, g, b]
240.             .map((v) => Math.round(v).toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
241.             .join("")}`;
242. 
243.           setPending(hex);
244.         }}
245.       >
246.         <ColorPickerSelection className="h-36 w-full" />
247.         <ColorPickerHue />
248.         <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
249.           <ColorPickerEyeDropper />
250.           <ColorPickerOutput />
251.           <ColorPickerFormat className="flex-1" />
252.         </div>
253.       </ColorPicker>
254. 
255.       {/* Opacity slider */}
256.       {onOpacityChange && (
257.         <div className="space-y-1.5">
258.           <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
259.             <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Transparenz</span>
260.             <span className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
261.               {opacity}%
262.             </span>
263.           </div>
264.           <Slider
265.             min={10}
266.             max={100}
267.             step={5}
268.             value={[opacity]}
269.             onValueChange={(values) => {
270.               const v = Array.isArray(values) ? values[0] : values;
271.               setOpacity(v);
272.               onOpacityChange(v);
273.             }}
274.           />
275.         </div>
276.       )}
277. 
278.       <Button size="sm" className="w-full" onClick={() => onConfirm(pending)}>
279.         Farbe übernehmen
280.       </Button>
281.     </div>
282.   );
283. }
284. 
285. export const LayerListItem = memo(function LayerListItem({

289.   duplicateCount = 0,
290.   editingLayerId,
291.   editingLayerName,

293.   onSelect,

295.   onConfirmEdit,

300.   onDelete,
301.   onDuplicateLayer,
302.   onToggleVisibility,
303.   onSoloLayer,
304.   onRemovePostalCode,
305.   onMovePlz,
306.   otherLayers = [],
307.   onImportCSV,
308.   onNotesChange,
309.   isSelected,
310.   onToggleSelect,
311.   dragHandleProps,
312.   isLocked = false,
313.   onToggleLock,

316.   onClearPLZ,
317.   onAddPlzRange,
318.   allCodesSetSize,

Implemented an instant-navigation + remount-performance fix set for postal-code flows.

### What I changed
- Enabled Next 16 instant navigation/runtimes on postal-code routes:
  - `src/app/(map)/postal-codes/page.tsx`: `export const instant = true`, `export const prefetch = "allow-runtime"`
  - `src/app/(map)/postal-codes/[areaId]/page.tsx`: same exports
- Removed invalid Next config that was breaking instant-nav diagnostics:
  - `next.config.ts`: removed `experimental.instantNavigationDevToolsToggle`
- Eliminated router/nuqs cascade on active-layer URL changes (key source of “feels like reload/remount” behavior):
  - `src/lib/url-state/map-state.ts`
  - Replaced `useQueryState("activeLayerId")` with direct `history.replaceState(..., "__nuqs__", ...)` + local popstate/force-update syncing
- Increased runtime prefetch coverage for hot route transitions by setting `prefetch` on area links used in postal-code workflows:
  - `src/components/areas/area-list-item.tsx`
  - `src/components/postal-codes/overview-area-list.tsx`
  - `src/components/postal-codes/postal-codes-overview.tsx`
  - `src/components/areas/recent-activity-feed.tsx`
  - `src/components/areas/plz-search.tsx`
  - `src/components/areas/area-comparison-dialog.tsx`

### Observed result
- Next-browser diagnostics now show **no config errors**.
- During repeated layer switches/legend interactions on `/postal-codes/78`, profiling showed the map stayed mounted (no full-map remount loop), and the URL active-layer updates no longer go through the heavy router/nuqs path.

### Checks
- `bun run type-check` passed.
- `bun run check` still fails due an existing Ultracite/Oxlint config parse issue in `node_modules/ultracite/...` (environment/baseline issue, not introduced by these changes).

<sub>11m 32s</sub>

### ✓ Task Complete

Implemented an instant-navigation + remount-performance fix set for postal-code flows.

### What I changed
- Enabled Next 16 instant navigation/runtimes on postal-code routes:
  - `src/app/(map)/postal-codes/page.tsx`: `export const instant = true`, `export const prefetch = "allow-runtime"`
  - `src/app/(map)/postal-codes/[areaId]/page.tsx`: same exports
- Removed invalid Next config that was breaking instant-nav diagnostics:
  - `next.config.ts`: removed `experimental.instantNavigationDevToolsToggle`
- Eliminated router/nuqs cascade on active-layer URL changes (key source of “feels like reload/remount” behavior):
  - `src/lib/url-state/map-state.ts`
  - Replaced `useQueryState("activeLayerId")` with direct `history.replaceState(..., "__nuqs__", ...)` + local popstate/force-update syncing
- Increased runtime prefetch coverage for hot route transitions by setting `prefetch` on area links used in postal-code workflows:
  - `src/components/areas/area-list-item.tsx`
  - `src/components/postal-codes/overview-area-list.tsx`
  - `src/components/postal-codes/postal-codes-overview.tsx`
  - `src/components/areas/recent-activity-feed.tsx`
  - `src/components/areas/plz-search.tsx`
  - `src/components/areas/area-comparison-dialog.tsx`

### Observed result
- Next-browser diagnostics now show **no config errors**.
- During repeated layer switches/legend interactions on `/postal-codes/78`, profiling showed the map stayed mounted (no full-map remount loop), and the URL active-layer updates no longer go through the heavy router/nuqs path.

### Checks
- `bun run type-check` passed.
- `bun run check` still fails due an existing Ultracite/Oxlint config parse issue in `node_modules/ultracite/...` (environment/baseline issue, not introduced by these changes).

200. export async function deleteAreaAction(id: number) {
201.   let redirectPath: string | null = null;
202. 
203.   try {
204.     // Delete in correct order due to foreign key constraints
205. 
206.     await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
207.       // First delete all postal codes from layers in this area
208. 
209.       const areaLayerIds = await tx
210. 
211.         .select({ id: areaLayers.id })
212. 
213.         .from(areaLayers)

221. 
222.             areaLayerIds.map((l) => l.id)
223.           )
224.         );
225. 
226.         // Then delete the layers
227. 
228.         await tx.delete(areaLayers).where(eq(areaLayers.areaId, id));
229.       }
230. 
231.       // Finally delete the area
232. 
233.       await tx.delete(areas).where(eq(areas.id, id));
234.     });
235. 
236.     updateTag("areas");
237. 
238.     // Set redirect path for finally block
239.     redirectPath = "/postal-codes";

241.     console.error("Error deleting area:", error);
242. 
243.     return { success: false, error: "Failed to delete area" };
244.   } finally {
245.     // Redirect in finally block for cleaner resource management
246.     if (redirectPath) {
247.       redirect(redirectPath as Route);
248.     }
249.   }
250. }

274. export async function exportAreaGeoJSONAction(
275.   areaId: number
276. ): ServerActionResponse<string> {
277.   try {
278.     const { rows } = await db.execute<{
279.       layer_id: number;
280.       layer_name: string;
281.       layer_color: string;
282.       layer_order: number;
283.       geometry: string | null;
284.       postal_codes: string[];
285.     }>(sql`
286.       SELECT
287.         al.id AS layer_id,
288.         al.name AS layer_name,
289.         al.color AS layer_color,
290.         al.order_index AS layer_order,
291.         ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Union(pc.geometry))::text AS geometry,
292.         array_agg(alpc.postal_code ORDER BY alpc.postal_code) AS postal_codes
293.       FROM area_layers al
294.       LEFT JOIN area_layer_postal_codes alpc ON alpc.layer_id = al.id
295.       LEFT JOIN postal_codes pc ON pc.id = alpc.postal_code_id
296.       WHERE al.area_id = ${areaId}
297.       GROUP BY al.id, al.name, al.color, al.order_index
298.       ORDER BY al.order_index ASC
299.     `);
300. 
301.     const features = rows
302.       .filter((r) => r.geometry !== null)
303.       .map((r) => ({
304.         type: "Feature" as const,
305.         geometry: JSON.parse(r.geometry!),
306.         properties: {
307.           layerId: r.layer_id,
308.           name: r.layer_name,
309.           color: r.layer_color,
310.           order: r.layer_order,
311.           postalCodes: r.postal_codes ?? [],
312.           postalCodeCount: (r.postal_codes ?? []).length,
313.         },
314.       }));
315. 
316.     const geojson = {
317.       type: "FeatureCollection",
318.       features,
319.     };
320. 
321.     return { success: true, data: JSON.stringify(geojson, null, 2) };
322.   } catch (error) {
323.     console.error("Error exporting GeoJSON:", error);
324.     return { success: false, error: "GeoJSON Export fehlgeschlagen" };
325.   }
326. }

395. export async function importAreaFromDataAction(
396.   jsonData: string,
397.   createdBy?: string
398. ): ServerActionResponse<{ areaId: number }> {
399.   let redirectPath: string | null = null;
400. 
401.   try {
402.     const raw = JSON.parse(jsonData) as AreaExportData;
403.     if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object" || raw.version !== 1) {
404.       return { success: false, error: "Ungültiges Dateiformat" };
405.     }
406. 
407.     let newAreaId: number | null = null;
408. 
409.     await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
410.       const [newArea] = await tx
411.         .insert(areas)
412.         .values({
413.           name: raw.name,
414.           description: raw.description ?? undefined,
415.           granularity: raw.granularity ?? "5digit",
416.           country: raw.country ?? "DE",
417.         })
418.         .returning();
419. 
420.       newAreaId = newArea.id;
421. 
422.       // Import tags: find or create each tag, then assign to area
423.       if (Array.isArray(raw.tags) && raw.tags.length > 0) {
424.         for (const tagData of raw.tags) {
425.           if (!tagData.name?.trim()) continue;
426.           // Find existing tag by name (case-insensitive) or create it
427.           const existing = await tx.query.areaTags.findFirst({
428.             where: (t, { sql: s }) =>
429.               s`lower(${t.name}) = lower(${tagData.name.trim()})`,
430.           });
431.           const tagId =
432.             existing?.id ??
433.             (
434.               await tx
435.                 .insert(areaTags)
436.                 .values({
437.                   name: tagData.name.trim(),
438.                   color: tagData.color ?? "#6366f1",
439.                 })
440.                 .returning()
441.             )[0].id;
442.           await tx
443.             .insert(areaTagAssignments)
444.             .values({ areaId: newArea.id, tagId })
445.             .onConflictDoNothing();
446.         }
447.       }
448. 
449.       for (const layerData of raw.layers) {
450.         const [newLayer] = await tx
451.           .insert(areaLayers)
452.           .values({

496. export async function duplicateAreaAction(
497.   sourceAreaId: number,
498.   customName?: string
499. ) {
500.   let redirectPath: string | null = null;
501. 
502.   try {
503.     await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
504.       // 1. Read source area
505.       const [sourceArea] = await tx
506.         .select()
507.         .from(areas)
508.         .where(eq(areas.id, sourceAreaId));
509. 
510.       if (!sourceArea) {
511.         throw new Error("Gebiet nicht gefunden");
512.       }
513. 
514.       // 2. Create new area
515.       const [newArea] = await tx
516.         .insert(areas)
517.         .values({
518.           name: customName?.trim() || `${sourceArea.name} (Kopie)`,
519.           description: sourceArea.description,
520.           granularity: sourceArea.granularity,
521.           country: sourceArea.country,
522.         })
523.         .returning();
524. 
525.       // 3. Read source layers with postal codes
526.       const sourceLayers = await tx
527.         .select()
528.         .from(areaLayers)
529.         .where(eq(areaLayers.areaId, sourceAreaId))
530.         .orderBy(areaLayers.orderIndex);
531. 
532.       // 4. Copy each layer and its postal codes
533.       for (const layer of sourceLayers) {
534.         const [newLayer] = await tx
535.           .insert(areaLayers)
536.           .values({
537.             areaId: newArea.id,
538.             name: layer.name,
539.             color: layer.color,
540.             opacity: layer.opacity,
541.             isVisible: layer.isVisible,
542.             orderIndex: layer.orderIndex,
543.           })
544.           .returning();
545. 
546.         const codes = await tx
547.           .select({ postalCode: areaLayerPostalCodes.postalCode })
548.           .from(areaLayerPostalCodes)
549.           .where(eq(areaLayerPostalCodes.layerId, layer.id));
550. 
551.         if (codes.length > 0) {
552.           await tx.insert(areaLayerPostalCodes).values(
553.             codes.map((c) => ({
554.               layerId: newLayer.id,
555.               postalCode: c.postalCode,
556.             }))
557.           );
558.         }
559.       }
560. 
561.       // 5. Copy tag assignments
562.       const sourceTags = await tx
563.         .select({ tagId: areaTagAssignments.tagId })
564.         .from(areaTagAssignments)
565.         .where(eq(areaTagAssignments.areaId, sourceAreaId));
566. 
567.       if (sourceTags.length > 0) {
568.         await tx
569.           .insert(areaTagAssignments)
570.           .values(
571.             sourceTags.map((t) => ({ areaId: newArea.id, tagId: t.tagId }))
572.           );
573.       }
574. 
575.       // 6. Create initial version
576.       const { createVersionAction } = await import("./version-actions");
577.       await createVersionAction(newArea.id, {
578.         name: "Erstversion",
579.         description: `Dupliziert von "${sourceArea.name}"`,
580.       });
581. 
582.       updateTag("areas");
583.       updateTag(`area-${newArea.id}`);
584.       redirectPath = `/postal-codes/${newArea.id}`;
585.     });
586.   } catch (error) {
587.     console.error("Error duplicating area:", error);
588.     return { success: false, error: "Failed to duplicate area" };
589.   } finally {
590.     if (redirectPath) {
591.       redirect(redirectPath as Route);
592.     }
593.   }
594. }

1. import { useEffect, useMemo, useReducer, useRef, useTransition } from "react";
2. 
3. import { DACH_CENTER, DACH_ZOOM } from "../config/countries";
4. import { useStableCallback } from "../hooks/use-stable-callback";
5. 
6. const DEFAULT_CENTER = DACH_CENTER;
7. const DEFAULT_ZOOM = DACH_ZOOM;
8. 
9. function parseMapViewFromSearch(search: string) {
10.   const params = new URLSearchParams(search);
11.   const raw = params.get("mapView");
12.   if (!raw)
13.     return { center: DEFAULT_CENTER as [number, number], zoom: DEFAULT_ZOOM };
14.   try {
15.     return JSON.parse(raw) as { center: [number, number]; zoom: number };
16.   } catch {
17.     return { center: DEFAULT_CENTER as [number, number], zoom: DEFAULT_ZOOM };
18.   }
19. }
20. 
21. // Reads mapView directly from window.location — bypasses nuqs to prevent
22. // the full Router cascade that fires on every replaceState during map pan.
23. // Only subscribes to popstate (back/forward navigation), not pan/zoom writes.
24. export function useMapView() {
25.   const [, forceUpdate] = useReducer((x: number) => x + 1, 0);
26. 
27.   useEffect(() => {
28.     window.addEventListener("popstate", forceUpdate);
29.     return () => window.removeEventListener("popstate", forceUpdate);
30.   }, []);
31. 
32.   const parsed = parseMapViewFromSearch(
33.     typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.location.search : ""
34.   );
35. 
36.   const parsedLng = parsed.center[0];
37.   const parsedLat = parsed.center[1];
38. 
39.   const prevCenterRef = useRef<[number, number]>([parsedLng, parsedLat]);
40.   const stableCenter = useMemo(() => {
41.     const [prevLng, prevLat] = prevCenterRef.current;
42.     if (parsedLng === prevLng && parsedLat === prevLat) {
43.       return prevCenterRef.current;
44.     }
45.     const next: [number, number] = [parsedLng, parsedLat];
46.     prevCenterRef.current = next;
47.     return next;
48.   }, [parsedLng, parsedLat]);
49. 
50.   const setMapView = useStableCallback(
51.     (view: { center: [number, number]; zoom: number }) => {
52.       const url = new URL(window.location.href);
53.       url.searchParams.set("mapView", JSON.stringify(view));
54.       // "__nuqs__" marker tells nuqs's history patch to skip sync — prevents
55.       // all nuqs consumers from re-rendering on every map pan/zoom write.
56.       window.history.replaceState(
57.         window.history.state,
58.         "__nuqs__",
59.         url.toString()
60.       );
61.     }
62.   );
63. 
64.   return [{ center: stableCenter, zoom: parsed.zoom }, setMapView] as const;
65. }
66. 
67. // Narrow hook: only active layer ID and setter (client-only, no server re-render)
68. export function useActiveLayerState() {
69.   const [, forceUpdate] = useReducer((x: number) => x + 1, 0);
70.   const [isLayerPending, startLayerTransition] = useTransition();
71. 
72.   useEffect(() => {
73.     window.addEventListener("popstate", forceUpdate);
74.     return () => window.removeEventListener("popstate", forceUpdate);
75.   }, []);
76. 
77.   const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(
78.     typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.location.search : ""
79.   );
80.   const activeLayerId = searchParams.get("activeLayerId");
81. 
82.   const parsedActiveLayerId = useMemo(
83.     () => (activeLayerId ? Number.parseInt(activeLayerId, 10) : null),
84.     [activeLayerId]
85.   );
86. 
87.   const setActiveLayer = useStableCallback((id: number | null) => {
88.     startLayerTransition(() => {
89.       const url = new URL(window.location.href);
90.       if (id !== null) {
91.         url.searchParams.set("activeLayerId", id.toString());
92.       } else {
93.         url.searchParams.delete("activeLayerId");
94.       }
95.       // "__nuqs__" marker keeps nuqs/router sync from cascading through the app.
96.       window.history.replaceState(window.history.state, "__nuqs__", url.toString());
97.       forceUpdate();
98.     });
99.   });
100. 
101.   return { activeLayerId: parsedActiveLayerId, isLayerPending, setActiveLayer };
102. }

111.     window.history.replaceState(
112.       window.history.state,
113.       "__nuqs__",
114.       url.toString()
115.     );
116.   });
117. }

302.     );
303. 
304.     // Normalize incoming codes: detect country prefix, convert to stored format
305.     const normalized = inputCodes
306.       .map((code) => {
307.         const detected = detectCountryFromCode(code);
308.         const country = (detected.country ?? areaCountry) as CountryCode;
309.         const rawCode = detected.code;
310.         if (!rawCode || rawCode.length < 1 || rawCode.length > 6) return null;
311.         const storedCode = formatWithPrefix(rawCode, country);
312.         return { rawCode, country, storedCode };
313.       })
314.       .filter((x): x is NonNullable<typeof x> => x !== null);
315. 
316.     const toAdd = normalized.filter(
317.       ({ storedCode }) => !existingCodesSet.has(storedCode)
318.     );
319. 
320.     if (toAdd.length === 0) {
321.       return { success: true };
322.     }
323. 
324.     // Group by country for efficient postalCodeId look up
325.     const byCountry = new Map<CountryCode, string[]>();
326.     for (const { rawCode, country } of toAdd) {
327.       const arr = byCountry.get(country) ?? [];
328.       arr.push(rawCode);
329.       byCountry.set(country, arr);
330.     }
331. 
332.     // Bulk look up postalCodeId for each (country, rawCode) pair
333.     const postalCodeIdMap = new Map<string, number>(); // "country:rawCode" → id
334.     for (const [country, rawCodes] of byCountry) {
335.       const rows = await db
336.         .select({ id: postalCodes.id, code: postalCodes.code })
337.         .from(postalCodes)
338.         .where(
339.           and(
340.             inArray(postalCodes.code, rawCodes),
341.             eq(postalCodes.country, country),
342.             eq(postalCodes.granularity, areaGranularity)
343.           )
344.         );
345.       for (const row of rows) {
346.         postalCodeIdMap.set(`${country}:${row.code}`, row.id);
347.       }
348.     }
349. 
350.     // Build insert rows with stored-format postalCode and populated postalCodeId
351.     const insertRows = toAdd.map(({ rawCode, country, storedCode }) => ({
352.       layerId,
353.       postalCode: storedCode,
354.       postalCodeId: postalCodeIdMap.get(`${country}:${rawCode}`) ?? null,
355.     }));
356. 
357.     await db
358.       .insert(areaLayerPostalCodes)
359.       .values(insertRows)
360.       .onConflictDoNothing();
361. 
362.     const codesToAddStored = insertRows.map((r) => r.postalCode);
363. 
364.     await recordChangeAction(areaId, {
365.       changeType: "add_postal_codes",
366.       entityType: "postal_code",
367.       entityId: layerId,
368.       changeData: {
369.         postalCodes: codesToAddStored,
370.         layerId,
371.       },
372.       previousData: {
373.         postalCodes: [...existingCodesSet],
374.       },
375.       createdBy,
376.     });
377. 
378.     updateTag(`area-${areaId}-layers`);
379.     updateTag(`area-${areaId}`);
380.     updateTag(`area-${areaId}-undo-redo`);
381.     return { success: true };
382.   } catch (error) {
383.     console.error("Error adding postal codes to layer:", error);
384.     return { success: false, error: "Failed to add postal codes" };
385.   }
386. }
387. 
388. export async function removePostalCodesFromLayerAction(
389.   areaId: number,
390.   layerId: number,
391.   postalCodes: string[],
392.   createdBy?: string
393. ) {
394.   try {
395.     // Get existing postal codes for this layer
396.     const layer = await db.query.areaLayers.findFirst({
397.       where: eq(areaLayers.id, layerId),
398.       with: {
399.         postalCodes: true,
400.       },
401.     });
402. 
403.     if (!layer) {
404.       return { success: false, error: "Layer not found" };
405.     }
406. 
407.     const existingCodesSet = new Set(
408.       layer.postalCodes?.map((pc) => pc.postalCode) ?? []
409.     );
410.     const codesToRemove = postalCodes.filter((code) =>
411.       existingCodesSet.has(code)
412.     );
413. 
414.     if (codesToRemove.length === 0) {
415.       return { success: true }; // No codes to remove
416.     }
417. 
418.     // Delta delete only the specified codes
419.     await db
420.       .delete(areaLayerPostalCodes)
421.       .where(
422.         and(
423.           eq(areaLayerPostalCodes.layerId, layerId),
424.           inArray(areaLayerPostalCodes.postalCode, codesToRemove)
425.         )
426.       );
427. 
428.     // Record change
429.     await recordChangeAction(areaId, {
430.       changeType: "remove_postal_codes",
431.       entityType: "postal_code",
432.       entityId: layerId,
433.       changeData: {
434.         postalCodes: codesToRemove,
435.         layerId,
436.       },
437.       previousData: {
438.         postalCodes: codesToRemove, // Store removed codes for undo
439.       },
440.       createdBy,
441.     });
442. 
443.     updateTag(`area-${areaId}-layers`);
444.     updateTag(`area-${areaId}`);
445.     updateTag(`area-${areaId}-undo-redo`);
446.     return { success: true };
447.   } catch (error) {
448.     console.error("Error removing postal codes from layer:", error);
449.     return { success: false, error: "Failed to remove postal codes" };
450.   }
451. }
452.

454.  * Merge all postal codes from sourceLayerId into targetLayerId,
455.  * then delete the source layer.
456.  */
457. export async function mergeLayersAction(

460.   targetLayerId: number

45. /**
46.  * Comprehensive hook for managing all map interactions.
47.  * Combines drawing tools and TerraDraw functionality.
48.  * Hover and click are now handled by deck.gl picking (via useDeckLayers onHover + onClick callback).
49.  */
50. export function useMapInteractions({
51.   mapRef,
52.   data,
53.   isMapLoaded,
54.   areaId,
55.   activeLayerId,
56.   layers,
57.   addPostalCodesToLayer,
58.   removePostalCodesFromLayer,
59.   onNeedsReassign,
60. }: UseMapInteractionsProps) {
61.   // Drawing tools state management
62.   const {
63.     currentDrawingMode,
64.     isDrawingToolsVisible,
65.     isCursorMode,
66.     isDrawingActive,
67.     handleDrawingModeChange,
68.     showTools,
69.     hideTools,
70.     editingFeatureId,
71.     handleFeatureSelect,
72.     handleFeatureDeselect,
73.   } = useMapDrawingTools();
74. 
75.   // TerraDraw selection logic
76.   const {
77.     terraDrawRef,
78.     handleTerraDrawSelection,
79.     clearAll: clearAllDrawings,
80.     pendingPostalCodes,
81.     addPendingToSelection,
82.     removePendingFromSelection,
83.   } = useMapTerraDrawSelection({
84.     mapRef,
85.     data,
86.   });
87. 
88.   // Synchronous flag: set when TerraDraw fires select/deselect on the same
89.   // click that deck.gl's onClick would also fire. Shape interactions always
90.   // take priority over postal-code toggling.
91.   const terraEventFiredRef = useRef(false);
92. 
93.   const guardedFeatureSelect = useStableCallback((id: string) => {
94.     terraEventFiredRef.current = true;
95.     handleFeatureSelect(id);
96.     requestAnimationFrame(() => {
97.       terraEventFiredRef.current = false;
98.     });
99.   });
100. 
101.   const guardedFeatureDeselect = useStableCallback(() => {
102.     terraEventFiredRef.current = true;
103.     handleFeatureDeselect();
104.     requestAnimationFrame(() => {
105.       terraEventFiredRef.current = false;
106.     });
107.   });
108. 
109.   // TerraDraw integration
110.   const terraDrawApi = useTerraDraw({
111.     mapRef,
112.     isMapLoaded,
113.     isEnabled: isDrawingActive,
114.     mode: isDrawingActive ? currentDrawingMode : null,
115.     onSelectionChange: handleTerraDrawSelection,
116.     onFeatureSelect: guardedFeatureSelect,
117.     onFeatureDeselect: guardedFeatureDeselect,
118.   });
119. 
120.   // Always assign terraDrawRef for stability
121.   terraDrawRef.current = terraDrawApi;
122. 
123.   // Clear all drawings + pending postal codes + editing state
124.   const clearAll = useStableCallback(() => {
125.     clearAllDrawings();
126.     handleFeatureDeselect();
127.   });
128. 
129.   // Delete only the currently-selected drawing
130.   const deleteEditingFeature = useStableCallback(() => {
131.     if (!editingFeatureId) {
132.       return;
133.     }
134.     terraDrawApi.removeFeatures([editingFeatureId]);
135.     handleFeatureDeselect();
136.   });
137. 
138.   // Deselect the current drawing without deleting it
139.   const deselectEditingFeature = useStableCallback(() => {
140.     if (editingFeatureId) {
141.       terraDrawApi.deselectFeature(editingFeatureId);
142.     }
143.     handleFeatureDeselect();
144.   });
145. 
146.   // deck.gl click handler — replaces useMapClickInteraction
147.   const handleDeckClick = useCallback(
148.     async (info: PickingInfo) => {
149.       // Shape interactions take priority over postal-code clicks
150.       if (terraEventFiredRef.current || editingFeatureId) {
151.         return;
152.       }
153. 
154.       if (!isCursorMode || !info.object) {
155.         return;
156.       }
157. 
158.       // Get stored-format code ("D-12345" / "A-1010" / "CH-3800") for DB operations
159.       const storedCode = getFeatureStoredCode(info.object);
160.       if (!storedCode) {
161.         return;
162.       }
163. 
164.       if (!areaId || !activeLayerId || areaId <= 0) {
165.         toast.info(
166.           `PLZ ${storedCode} - Bitte wählen Sie einen Bereich und aktiven Layer aus`,
167.           { duration: 3000 }
168.         );
169.         return;
170.       }
171. 
172.       if (!addPostalCodesToLayer || !removePostalCodesFromLayer) {
173.         toast.warning("Layer-Operationen nicht verfügbar", { duration: 2000 });
174.         return;
175.       }
176. 
177.       const activeLayer = layers?.find((l) => l.id === activeLayerId);
178.       if (!activeLayer) {
179.         toast.warning(
180.           `Aktiver Layer (ID: ${activeLayerId}) nicht gefunden. Verfügbare Layer: ${layers?.length || 0}`,
181.           { duration: 3000 }
182.         );
183.         return;
184.       }
185. 
186.       const existingCodesSet = new Set(
187.         activeLayer.postalCodes?.map((pc) => pc.postalCode)
188.       );
189.       const codeExists = existingCodesSet.has(storedCode);
190. 
191.       // Find layers (other than active) that also contain this PLZ
192.       const otherLayersWithCode = (layers ?? []).filter(
193.         (l) =>
194.           l.id !== activeLayerId &&
195.           l.postalCodes?.some((pc) => pc.postalCode === storedCode)
196.       );
197. 
198.       try {
199.         if (codeExists) {
200.           // PLZ is in the active layer → remove it
201.           await removePostalCodesFromLayer(activeLayerId, [storedCode]);
202.           toast.success(`PLZ ${storedCode} aus Gebiet entfernt`, {
203.             duration: 2000,
204.           });
205.         } else if (otherLayersWithCode.length > 0 && onNeedsReassign) {
206.           // PLZ belongs to a different layer → ask user to reassign or duplicate
207.           onNeedsReassign({
208.             x: info.x ?? 0,
209.             y: info.y ?? 0,
210.             code: storedCode,
211.             containingLayers: otherLayersWithCode.map((l) => ({
212.               id: l.id,
213.               name: l.name,
214.               color: l.color ?? "#888",
215.             })),
216.           });
217.         } else {
218.           // PLZ not in any layer → add to active layer
219.           await addPostalCodesToLayer(activeLayerId, [storedCode]);
220.           toast.success(`PLZ ${storedCode} zu Gebiet hinzugefügt`, {
221.             duration: 2000,
222.           });
223.         }
224.       } catch {
225.         toast.error(`Fehler beim Bearbeiten von PLZ ${storedCode}`, {
226.           duration: 2000,
227.         });
228.       }
229.     },
230.     [
231.       isCursorMode,
232.       editingFeatureId,
233.       areaId,
234.       activeLayerId,
235.       layers,
236.       addPostalCodesToLayer,
237.       removePostalCodesFromLayer,
238.       onNeedsReassign,
239.     ]
240.   );
241. 
242.   return {
243.     // Drawing tools state
244.     currentDrawingMode,
245.     isDrawingToolsVisible,
246.     isCursorMode,
247.     // Drawing tools actions
248.     handleDrawingModeChange,
249.     showTools,
250.     hideTools,
251.     clearAll,
252.     // Editing state
253.     editingFeatureId,
254.     deleteEditingFeature,
255.     deselectEditingFeature,
256.     // deck.gl click handler
257.     handleDeckClick,
258.     // Pending postal codes from drawing
259.     pendingPostalCodes,
260.     addPendingToSelection,
261.     removePendingFromSelection,
262.   } as const;
263. }

<sub>20m 35s</sub>

### Copilot

You’re right — those regressions were introduced, and I’ve fixed them.

**Applied fixes:**
1. **`activeLayerId` URL state restored and stabilized** (`src/lib/url-state/map-state.ts`)  
   - Switched back to `useQueryState("activeLayerId")` with `history: "replace"` and `shallow: true`.
   - Removed the custom manual `history.replaceState` approach for `activeLayerId`.
   - This prevents the server-action roundtrip from dropping all query params and restores active-layer switching behavior.

2. **Right-click map behavior fixed** (`src/components/shared/base-map.tsx`)  
   - Added `dragRotate={false}` on `\<Map />` so right-drag no longer rotates/shifts view unexpectedly.

3. **FPS regression source removed**  
   - The aggressive explicit runtime prefetching on many area links was rolled back (so you don’t trigger heavy per-link runtime prefetch load across large lists).

The earlier instant-navigation route config changes remain in place, and config errors are clean now.

153. function blendAccumulator(acc: StyleAccumulator): ResolvedStyle {
154.   const weight = Math.max(acc.weightSum, 1);
155.   const avgFill: [number, number, number, number] = [
156.     Math.round(acc.fillWeighted[0] / weight),
157.     Math.round(acc.fillWeighted[1] / weight),
158.     Math.round(acc.fillWeighted[2] / weight),
159.     Math.round(acc.fillWeighted[3] / weight),
160.   ];
161.   const avgLine: [number, number, number, number] = [
162.     Math.round(acc.lineWeighted[0] / weight),
163.     Math.round(acc.lineWeighted[1] / weight),
164.     Math.round(acc.lineWeighted[2] / weight),
165.     255,
166.   ];
167. 
168.   // Detect same-color conflict: all contributing layers share similar hue
169.   let isSameColor = false;
170.   if (acc.count >= 2 && acc.layerColors.length >= 2) {
171.     isSameColor = acc.layerColors.every((c) =>
172.       hexColorsAreSimilar(acc.layerColors[0], c, 60)
173.     );
174.   }
175. 
176.   // Extract RGB colors from layerFillEntries for the outline
177.   const layerLineColors = acc.layerFillEntries.map((entry) => {
178.     const [r, g, b] = entry.color;
179.     return [r, g, b, 255] as [number, number, number, number];
180.   });
181. 
182.   if (acc.count <= 1) {
183.     return {
184.       fillColor: avgFill,
185.       primaryFillColor: avgFill,
186.       secondaryFillColor: avgFill,
187.       lineColor: avgLine,
188.       lineWidth: acc.hasActive ? 2.5 : 1.5,
189.       count: acc.count,
190.       isSameColor: false,
191.       layerLineColors,
192.     };
193.   }
194. 
195.   // Primary: active layer's color (or first layer if none active) — same alpha as single-layer fills
196.   const primaryEntry =
197.     acc.layerFillEntries.find((e) => e.isActive) ?? acc.layerFillEntries[0];
198.   const primaryFillColor: RgbaColor = primaryEntry
199.     ? primaryEntry.color
200.     : avgFill;
201. 
202.   // Secondary: blend of all other layers' fill colors — same alpha as single-layer fills
203.   const secondaryEntries = acc.layerFillEntries.filter(
204.     (e) => e !== primaryEntry
205.   );
206.   let secondaryFillColor: RgbaColor;
207.   if (secondaryEntries.length === 0) {
208.     secondaryFillColor = primaryFillColor;
209.   } else if (secondaryEntries.length === 1) {
210.     secondaryFillColor = secondaryEntries[0].color;
211.   } else {
212.     const n = secondaryEntries.length;
213.     secondaryFillColor = [
214.       Math.round(secondaryEntries.reduce((s, e) => s + e.color[0], 0) / n),
215.       Math.round(secondaryEntries.reduce((s, e) => s + e.color[1], 0) / n),
216.       Math.round(secondaryEntries.reduce((s, e) => s + e.color[2], 0) / n),
217.       Math.round(secondaryEntries.reduce((s, e) => s + e.color[3], 0) / n),
218.     ];
219.   }
220. 
221.   return {
222.     fillColor: [
223.       avgFill[0],
224.       avgFill[1],
225.       avgFill[2],
226.       Math.min(210, avgFill[3] + 45),
227.     ],
228.     primaryFillColor,
229.     secondaryFillColor,
230.     lineColor: [avgLine[0], avgLine[1], avgLine[2], 255],
231.     lineWidth: acc.hasActive ? 2.5 : 1.5,
232.     count: acc.count,
233.     isSameColor,
234.     layerLineColors,
235.   };
236. }

238. /**
239.  * Build a Map from composite key (country:code) → resolved visual style.
240.  * Keys match the featureIndex format from getFeatureCode().
241.  * `country` is used to prefer the area's own country when resolving codes.
242.  * `featureIndex` enables cross-country resolution (e.g., AT codes in a DE area).
243.  *
244.  * Also returns `multiLayerCodes` (codes in 2+ visible layers) and
245.  * `sameColorCodes` (subset where all contributing layers share a similar color).
246.  */
247. function buildResolvedStyleMap(
248.   layers: Layer[] | undefined,
249.   activeLayerId: number | null | undefined,
250.   country?: string,
251.   featureIndex?: Map<string, Feature<Polygon | MultiPolygon>[]>
252. ): {
253.   map: Map<string, ResolvedStyle>;
254.   version: string;
255.   multiLayerCodes: Set<string>;
256.   sameColorCodes: Set<string>;
257. } {
258.   const result = new Map<string, ResolvedStyle>();
259.   const multiLayerCodes = new Set<string>();
260.   const sameColorCodes = new Set<string>();
261. 
262.   if (!layers) {
263.     return { map: result, version: "", multiLayerCodes, sameColorCodes };
264.   }
265.   const byCode = new Map<string, StyleAccumulator>();
266.   const versionParts: string[] = [];
267. 
268.   for (const layer of layers) {
269.     if (layer.isVisible !== "true") {
270.       continue;
271.     }
272.     const postalCodes = layer.postalCodes?.map((pc) => pc.postalCode) ?? [];
273.     if (postalCodes.length === 0) {
274.       continue;
275.     }
276. 
277.     const isActive = activeLayerId === layer.id;
278.     const opacity = layer.opacity / 100;
279.     const fillColor = hexToRgba(layer.color, opacity * 0.6);
280.     const lineColor = hexToRgba(layer.color, isActive ? 0.9 : 0.7);
281. 
282.     versionParts.push(`${layer.id}:${layer.color}:${opacity}:${isActive}`);
283. 
284.     for (const rawCode of postalCodes) {
285.       const key = resolveFeatureKey(rawCode, country, featureIndex);
286.       const existing = byCode.get(key) ?? toAccumulator();
287.       const weight = isActive ? 2 : 1;
288.       existing.fillWeighted = [
289.         existing.fillWeighted[0] + fillColor[0] * weight,
290.         existing.fillWeighted[1] + fillColor[1] * weight,
291.         existing.fillWeighted[2] + fillColor[2] * weight,
292.         existing.fillWeighted[3] + fillColor[3] * weight,
293.       ];
294.       existing.lineWeighted = [
295.         existing.lineWeighted[0] + lineColor[0] * weight,
296.         existing.lineWeighted[1] + lineColor[1] * weight,
297.         existing.lineWeighted[2] + lineColor[2] * weight,
298.         existing.lineWeighted[3] + lineColor[3] * weight,
299.       ];
300.       existing.weightSum += weight;
301.       existing.hasActive = existing.hasActive || isActive;
302.       existing.count += 1;
303.       existing.layerColors.push(layer.color);
304.       existing.layerFillEntries.push({ color: fillColor, isActive });
305.       byCode.set(key, existing);
306.     }
307.   }
308. 
309.   for (const [code, acc] of byCode) {
310.     const style = blendAccumulator(acc);
311.     // Preserve existing behavior where single-layer width follows active state.
312.     if (acc.count <= 1) {
313.       style.lineWidth = acc.hasActive ? 2.5 : 1.5;
314.     }
315.     // Keep a soft minimum for visibility.
316.     style.lineWidth = Math.max(style.lineWidth, 1.5);
317.     result.set(code, style);
318. 
319.     if (acc.count >= 2) {
320.       multiLayerCodes.add(code);
321.       if (style.isSameColor) {
322.         sameColorCodes.add(code);
323.       }
324.     }
325.   }
326. 
327.   return {
328.     map: result,
329.     version: versionParts.join("|"),
330.     multiLayerCodes,
331.     sameColorCodes,
332.   };
333. }

1. import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
2. import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
3. 
4. import { db } from "@/lib/db";
5. 
6. interface LayerOutlineRow {
7.   layerId: number;
8.   color: string;
9.   opacity: number;
10.   outline: string | null;
11. }
12. 
13. export async function GET(
14.   _request: Request,
15.   { params }: { params: Promise<{ areaId: string }> }
16. ) {
17.   const { areaId } = await params;
18.   const id = Number.parseInt(areaId, 10);
19.   if (Number.isNaN(id)) {
20.     return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid areaId" }, { status: 400 });
21.   }
22. 
23.   try {
24.     // Union all postal code geometries per visible layer using PostGIS.
25.     // ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology at 0.002 (~200m) keeps the outline smooth
26.     // without being too coarse. Join via postalCodeId FK for correct cross-country
27.     // DACH resolution (codes are stored in "D-12345"/"A-1010"/"CH-3800" format).
28.     const { rows } = await db.execute(sql`
29.       SELECT
30.         l.id                                                          AS "layerId",
31.         l.color,
32.         l.opacity,
33.         ST_AsGeoJSON(
34.           ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology(
35.             ST_Union(pc.geometry),
36.             0.002
37.           )
38.         )                                                             AS outline
39.       FROM area_layers       l
40.       JOIN area_layer_postal_codes alpc
41.                                  ON alpc.layer_id  = l.id
42.       JOIN postal_codes      pc  ON pc.id          = alpc.postal_code_id
43.       WHERE l.area_id    = ${id}
44.         AND l.is_visible = 'true'
45.       GROUP BY l.id, l.color, l.opacity
46.     `);
47. 
48.     const result = (rows as unknown as LayerOutlineRow[])
49.       .filter((r) => r.outline !== null)
50.       .map((r) => ({
51.         layerId: r.layerId,
52.         color: r.color,
53.         opacity: r.opacity,
54.         outline: JSON.parse(r.outline as string),
55.       }));
56. 
57.     return NextResponse.json(result, {
58.       headers: {
59.         "Cache-Control": "no-store",
60.       },
61.     });
62.   } catch (error) {
63.     console.error("Error computing layer outlines:", error);
64.     return NextResponse.json(
65.       { error: "Failed to compute layer outlines" },
66.       { status: 500 }
67.     );
68.   }
69. }
70.
```

1. import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

5.   getPostalCodesDataForGranularity,

9. const VALID_GRANULARITIES = new Set([
10.   "1digit",
11.   "2digit",
12.   "3digit",
13.   "4digit",
14.   "5digit",
15.   "native",
16. ]);
17. 
18. export async function GET(
19.   request: Request,
20.   { params }: { params: Promise<{ granularity: string }> }
21. ) {
22.   const { granularity } = await params;
23.   const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
24.   const countryParam = searchParams.get("country");
25.   const country: CountryCode | undefined =
26.     countryParam && isValidCountryCode(countryParam) ? countryParam : undefined;
27. 
28.   if (!VALID_GRANULARITIES.has(granularity)) {
29.     return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid granularity" }, { status: 400 });
30.   }
31. 
32.   // "native" = each country at its full resolution (DE@5digit + AT@4digit + CH@4digit)
33.   const data =
34.     granularity === "native"
35.       ? await getNativePostalCodesData()
36.       : await getPostalCodesDataForGranularity(granularity, country);
37. 
38.   const json = JSON.stringify(data);
39.   const stream = new Blob([json]).stream().pipeThrough(
40.     new CompressionStream("gzip")
41.   );
42. 
43.   return new Response(stream, {
44.     headers: {
45.       "Content-Type": "application/json",
46.       "Content-Encoding": "gzip",
47.       "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=3600, stale-while-revalidate=86400",
48.     },

50. }

154.   const weight = Math.max(acc.weightSum, 1);
155.   const avgFill: [number, number, number, number] = [

157.     Math.round(acc.fillWeighted[1] / weight),

181. 
182.   if (acc.count <= 1) {

48.  * Hover and click are now handled by deck.gl picking (via useDeckLayers onHover + onClick callback).
49.  */
50. export function useMapInteractions({
51.   mapRef,
52.   data,
53.   isMapLoaded,
54.   areaId,
55.   activeLayerId,
56.   layers,
57.   addPostalCodesToLayer,
58.   removePostalCodesFromLayer,
59.   onNeedsReassign,
60. }: UseMapInteractionsProps) {
61.   // Drawing tools state management
62.   const {
63.     currentDrawingMode,
64.     isDrawingToolsVisible,
65.     isCursorMode,
66.     isDrawingActive,
67.     handleDrawingModeChange,
68.     showTools,
69.     hideTools,
70.     editingFeatureId,
71.     handleFeatureSelect,
72.     handleFeatureDeselect,
73.   } = useMapDrawingTools();
74. 
75.   // TerraDraw selection logic
76.   const {
77.     terraDrawRef,
78.     handleTerraDrawSelection,
79.     clearAll: clearAllDrawings,
80.     pendingPostalCodes,
81.     addPendingToSelection,
82.     removePendingFromSelection,
83.   } = useMapTerraDrawSelection({
84.     mapRef,
85.     data,
86.   });
87. 
88.   // Synchronous flag: set when TerraDraw fires select/deselect on the same
89.   // click that deck.gl's onClick would also fire. Shape interactions always
90.   // take priority over postal-code toggling.
91.   const terraEventFiredRef = useRef(false);
92. 
93.   const guardedFeatureSelect = useStableCallback((id: string) => {
94.     terraEventFiredRef.current = true;
95.     handleFeatureSelect(id);
96.     requestAnimationFrame(() => {
97.       terraEventFiredRef.current = false;
98.     });
99.   });
100. 
101.   const guardedFeatureDeselect = useStableCallback(() => {
102.     terraEventFiredRef.current = true;
103.     handleFeatureDeselect();
104.     requestAnimationFrame(() => {
105.       terraEventFiredRef.current = false;
106.     });
107.   });
108. 
109.   // TerraDraw integration
110.   const terraDrawApi = useTerraDraw({
111.     mapRef,
112.     isMapLoaded,
113.     isEnabled: isDrawingActive,
114.     mode: isDrawingActive ? currentDrawingMode : null,
115.     onSelectionChange: handleTerraDrawSelection,
116.     onFeatureSelect: guardedFeatureSelect,
117.     onFeatureDeselect: guardedFeatureDeselect,
118.   });
119. 
120.   // Always assign terraDrawRef for stability
121.   terraDrawRef.current = terraDrawApi;
122. 
123.   // Clear all drawings + pending postal codes + editing state
124.   const clearAll = useStableCallback(() => {
125.     clearAllDrawings();
126.     handleFeatureDeselect();
127.   });
128. 
129.   // Delete only the currently-selected drawing
130.   const deleteEditingFeature = useStableCallback(() => {
131.     if (!editingFeatureId) {
132.       return;
133.     }
134.     terraDrawApi.removeFeatures([editingFeatureId]);
135.     handleFeatureDeselect();
136.   });
137. 
138.   // Deselect the current drawing without deleting it
139.   const deselectEditingFeature = useStableCallback(() => {
140.     if (editingFeatureId) {
141.       terraDrawApi.deselectFeature(editingFeatureId);
142.     }
143.     handleFeatureDeselect();
144.   });
145. 
146.   // deck.gl click handler — replaces useMapClickInteraction
147.   const handleDeckClick = useCallback(
148.     async (info: PickingInfo) => {
149.       // Shape interactions take priority over postal-code clicks
150.       if (terraEventFiredRef.current || editingFeatureId) {
151.         return;
152.       }
153. 
154.       if (!isCursorMode || !info.object) {
155.         return;
156.       }
157. 
158.       // Get stored-format code ("D-12345" / "A-1010" / "CH-3800") for DB operations
159.       const storedCode = getFeatureStoredCode(info.object);
160.       if (!storedCode) {
161.         return;
162.       }
163. 
164.       if (!areaId || !activeLayerId || areaId <= 0) {
165.         toast.info(
166.           `PLZ ${storedCode} - Bitte wählen Sie einen Bereich und aktiven Layer aus`,
167.           { duration: 3000 }
168.         );
169.         return;
170.       }
171. 
172.       if (!addPostalCodesToLayer || !removePostalCodesFromLayer) {
173.         toast.warning("Layer-Operationen nicht verfügbar", { duration: 2000 });
174.         return;
175.       }
176. 
177.       const activeLayer = layers?.find((l) => l.id === activeLayerId);
178.       if (!activeLayer) {
179.         toast.warning(
180.           `Aktiver Layer (ID: ${activeLayerId}) nicht gefunden. Verfügbare Layer: ${layers?.length || 0}`,
181.           { duration: 3000 }
182.         );
183.         return;
184.       }
185. 
186.       const existingCodesSet = new Set(
187.         activeLayer.postalCodes?.map((pc) => pc.postalCode)
188.       );
189.       const codeExists = existingCodesSet.has(storedCode);
190. 
191.       // Find layers (other than active) that also contain this PLZ
192.       const otherLayersWithCode = (layers ?? []).filter(
193.         (l) =>
194.           l.id !== activeLayerId &&
195.           l.postalCodes?.some((pc) => pc.postalCode === storedCode)
196.       );
197. 
198.       try {
199.         if (codeExists) {
200.           // PLZ is in the active layer → remove it
201.           await removePostalCodesFromLayer(activeLayerId, [storedCode]);
202.           toast.success(`PLZ ${storedCode} aus Gebiet entfernt`, {
203.             duration: 2000,
204.           });
205.         } else if (otherLayersWithCode.length > 0 && onNeedsReassign) {
206.           // PLZ belongs to a different layer → ask user to reassign or duplicate
207.           onNeedsReassign({
208.             x: info.x ?? 0,
209.             y: info.y ?? 0,
210.             code: storedCode,
211.             containingLayers: otherLayersWithCode.map((l) => ({
212.               id: l.id,
213.               name: l.name,
214.               color: l.color ?? "#888",
215.             })),
216.           });
217.         } else {
218.           // PLZ not in any layer → add to active layer
219.           await addPostalCodesToLayer(activeLayerId, [storedCode]);
220.           toast.success(`PLZ ${storedCode} zu Gebiet hinzugefügt`, {
221.             duration: 2000,
222.           });
223.         }
224.       } catch {
225.         toast.error(`Fehler beim Bearbeiten von PLZ ${storedCode}`, {
226.           duration: 2000,
227.         });
228.       }
229.     },
230.     [
231.       isCursorMode,
232.       editingFeatureId,
233.       areaId,
234.       activeLayerId,
235.       layers,
236.       addPostalCodesToLayer,
237.       removePostalCodesFromLayer,
238.       onNeedsReassign,
239.     ]
240.   );
241. 
242.   return {
243.     // Drawing tools state
244.     currentDrawingMode,
245.     isDrawingToolsVisible,
246.     isCursorMode,
247.     // Drawing tools actions
248.     handleDrawingModeChange,
249.     showTools,
250.     hideTools,
251.     clearAll,
252.     // Editing state
253.     editingFeatureId,
254.     deleteEditingFeature,
255.     deselectEditingFeature,
256.     // deck.gl click handler
257.     handleDeckClick,
258.     // Pending postal codes from drawing
259.     pendingPostalCodes,
260.     addPendingToSelection,
261.     removePendingFromSelection,

238. /**
239.  * Build a Map from composite key (country:code) → resolved visual style.
240.  * Keys match the featureIndex format from getFeatureCode().
241.  * `country` is used to prefer the area's own country when resolving codes.
242.  * `featureIndex` enables cross-country resolution (e.g., AT codes in a DE area).
243.  *
244.  * Also returns `multiLayerCodes` (codes in 2+ visible layers) and
245.  * `sameColorCodes` (subset where all contributing layers share a similar color).
246.  */
247. function buildResolvedStyleMap(
248.   layers: Layer[] | undefined,
249.   activeLayerId: number | null | undefined,
250.   country?: string,
251.   featureIndex?: Map<string, Feature<Polygon | MultiPolygon>[]>
252. ): {
253.   map: Map<string, ResolvedStyle>;
254.   version: string;
255.   multiLayerCodes: Set<string>;
256.   sameColorCodes: Set<string>;
257. } {
258.   const result = new Map<string, ResolvedStyle>();
259.   const multiLayerCodes = new Set<string>();
260.   const sameColorCodes = new Set<string>();
261. 
262.   if (!layers) {
263.     return { map: result, version: "", multiLayerCodes, sameColorCodes };
264.   }
265.   const byCode = new Map<string, StyleAccumulator>();
266.   const versionParts: string[] = [];
267. 
268.   for (const layer of layers) {
269.     if (layer.isVisible !== "true") {
270.       continue;
271.     }
272.     const postalCodes = layer.postalCodes?.map((pc) => pc.postalCode) ?? [];
273.     if (postalCodes.length === 0) {
274.       continue;
275.     }
276. 
277.     const isActive = activeLayerId === layer.id;
278.     const opacity = layer.opacity / 100;
279.     const fillColor = hexToRgba(layer.color, opacity * 0.6);
280.     const lineColor = hexToRgba(layer.color, isActive ? 0.9 : 0.7);
281. 
282.     versionParts.push(`${layer.id}:${layer.color}:${opacity}:${isActive}`);
283. 
284.     for (const rawCode of postalCodes) {
285.       const key = resolveFeatureKey(rawCode, country, featureIndex);
286.       const existing = byCode.get(key) ?? toAccumulator();
287.       const weight = isActive ? 2 : 1;
288.       existing.fillWeighted = [
289.         existing.fillWeighted[0] + fillColor[0] * weight,
290.         existing.fillWeighted[1] + fillColor[1] * weight,
291.         existing.fillWeighted[2] + fillColor[2] * weight,
292.         existing.fillWeighted[3] + fillColor[3] * weight,
293.       ];
294.       existing.lineWeighted = [
295.         existing.lineWeighted[0] + lineColor[0] * weight,
296.         existing.lineWeighted[1] + lineColor[1] * weight,
297.         existing.lineWeighted[2] + lineColor[2] * weight,
298.         existing.lineWeighted[3] + lineColor[3] * weight,
299.       ];
300.       existing.weightSum += weight;
301.       existing.hasActive = existing.hasActive || isActive;
302.       existing.count += 1;
303.       existing.layerColors.push(layer.color);
304.       existing.layerFillEntries.push({ color: fillColor, isActive });
305.       byCode.set(key, existing);
306.     }
307.   }
308. 
309.   for (const [code, acc] of byCode) {
310.     const style = blendAccumulator(acc);
311.     // Preserve existing behavior where single-layer width follows active state.
312.     if (acc.count <= 1) {
313.       style.lineWidth = acc.hasActive ? 2.5 : 1.5;
314.     }
315.     // Keep a soft minimum for visibility.
316.     style.lineWidth = Math.max(style.lineWidth, 1.5);
317.     result.set(code, style);
318. 
319.     if (acc.count >= 2) {
320.       multiLayerCodes.add(code);
321.       if (style.isSameColor) {
322.         sameColorCodes.add(code);
323.       }
324.     }
325.   }
326. 
327.   return {
328.     map: result,
329.     version: versionParts.join("|"),
330.     multiLayerCodes,
331.     sameColorCodes,
332.   };
333. }
334. 
335. /**
336.  * Pre-filter a FeatureCollection to only features present in the resolved style map.
337.  * Uses featureIndex for O(k) lookup when available.
338.  */
339. function filterAreaFeatures(
340.   data: FeatureCollection<Polygon | MultiPolygon>,
341.   codeSet: Set<string>,
342.   featureIndex?: Map<string, Feature<Polygon | MultiPolygon>[]>
343. ): FeatureCollection<Polygon | MultiPolygon> {
344.   if (codeSet.size === 0) {
345.     return EMPTY_FEATURE_COLLECTION as FeatureCollection<
346.       Polygon | MultiPolygon
347.     >;
348.   }
349. 
350.   const features: Feature<Polygon | MultiPolygon>[] = [];
351. 
352.   if (featureIndex) {
353.     for (const code of codeSet) {
354.       const fts = featureIndex.get(code);
355.       if (fts) {
356.         for (const ft of fts) {
357.           features.push(ft);
358.         }
359.       }
360.     }
361.   } else {
362.     for (const feature of data.features) {
363.       const code = getFeatureCode(feature);
364.       if (code && codeSet.has(code)) {
365.         features.push(feature);
366.       }
367.     }
368.   }
369. 
370.   return { type: "FeatureCollection", features };
371. }
372. 
373. interface UseDeckLayersProps {
374.   data: FeatureCollection<Polygon | MultiPolygon>;
375.   statesData?: FeatureCollection<Polygon | MultiPolygon> | null;
376.   countryShapesData?: FeatureCollection<Polygon | MultiPolygon> | null;
377.   layers?: Layer[];
378.   activeLayerId?: number | null;
379.   previewPostalCode?: string | null;
380.   featureIndex?: Map<string, Feature<Polygon | MultiPolygon>[]>;
381.   isCursorMode: boolean;
382.   mapCanvasRef: RefObject<HTMLCanvasElement | null>;
383.   /** Country code for the area — used to prefix raw postal codes for DACH matching. */
384.   country?: string;
385.   /** ID of basemap symbol layer to insert deck.gl layers before (for z-ordering). */
386.   beforeId?: string;
387.   /** Set of composite postal codes (e.g. "DE:12345") to highlight on the map. */
388.   highlightedCodes?: Set<string> | null;
389.   /** When true, renders a highlight overlay for postal codes not assigned to any layer. */
390.   showUnassigned?: boolean;
391.   /** Ref to the tooltip DOM element — updated directly to avoid React re-renders on hover. */
392.   hoverTooltipRef?: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
393.   /**
394.    * Ref to the MapboxOverlay instance (from DeckGLOverlay).
395.    * Hover outline is applied via overlay.setProps() directly — no React state change,
396.    * so MapInner does not re-render on every hover boundary crossing.
397.    */
398.   overlayRef?: MutableRefObject<MapboxOverlay | null>;
399. }
400. 
401. /**
402.  * Hook that returns all deck.gl layer instances for the map.
403.  * Only polygon/fill/interaction layers — labels stay in MapLibre (hybrid approach).
404.  */
405. export function useDeckLayers({
406.   data,
407.   statesData,
408.   countryShapesData,
409.   layers,
410.   activeLayerId,
411.   previewPostalCode,
412.   featureIndex,
413.   isCursorMode,
414.   mapCanvasRef,
415.   country,
416.   beforeId,
417.   highlightedCodes,
418.   showUnassigned = false,
419.   hoverTooltipRef,
420.   overlayRef,
421. }: UseDeckLayersProps) {
422.   // Hover tracking — ref only, no state. Hover updates go directly to overlay.setProps().
423.   const hoveredCodeRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
424.   // Always-current deckLayers reference for direct overlay updates in onHover.
425.   // Initialized empty; updated each render after deckLayers useMemo runs.
426.   const deckLayersRef = useRef<GeoJsonLayer[]>([]);
427. 
428.   // Stripe pattern texture atlas — created once per browser session (client-only)
429.   const stripeAtlas = useMemo(() => createStripePatternAtlas(), []);
430. 
431.   // Resolve per-postal-code styles from all area layers (keyed by country:code)
432.   const {
433.     map: resolvedStyles,
434.     version: resolvedStylesVersion,
435.     multiLayerCodes,
436.     sameColorCodes,
437.   } = useMemo(
438.     () => buildResolvedStyleMap(layers, activeLayerId, country, featureIndex),
439.     [layers, activeLayerId, country, featureIndex]
440.   );
441. 
442.   // Stable set of composite keys (country:code) across all visible layers.
443.   // Switching active layer changes styling but NOT which codes are in the set,
444.   // so areaFeaturesData avoids unnecessary recomputation on layer switches.
445.   const resolvedCodeSet = useMemo(() => {
446.     const codes = new Set<string>();
447.     if (!layers) {
448.       return codes;
449.     }
450.     for (const layer of layers) {
451.       if (layer.isVisible !== "true") {
452.         continue;
453.       }
454.       const postalCodes = layer.postalCodes?.map((pc) => pc.postalCode) ?? [];
455.       for (const rawCode of postalCodes) {
456.         codes.add(resolveFeatureKey(rawCode, country, featureIndex));
457.       }
458.     }
459.     return codes;
460.   }, [layers, country, featureIndex]);
```

13. ## Route Handlers
14. 
15. Route Handlers allow you to create custom request handlers for a given route using the Web [Request](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Request) and [Response](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Response) APIs.
16. 
17. <Image
18.   alt="Route.js Special File"
19.   srcLight="/docs/light/route-special-file.png"
20.   srcDark="/docs/dark/route-special-file.png"
21.   width="1600"
22.   height="444"
23. />
24. 
25. > **Good to know**: Route Handlers are only available inside the `app` directory. They are the equivalent of [API Routes](/docs/pages/building-your-application/routing/api-routes) inside the `pages` directory meaning you **do not** need to use API Routes and Route Handlers together.
26. 
27. ### Convention
28. 
29. Route Handlers are defined in a [`route.js|ts` file](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/route) inside the `app` directory:
30. 
31. ```ts filename="app/api/route.ts" switcher
32. export async function GET(request: Request) {}
33. ```
34. 
35. ```js filename="app/api/route.js" switcher
36. export async function GET(request) {}
37. ```
38. 
39. Route Handlers can be nested anywhere inside the `app` directory, similar to `page.js` and `layout.js`. But there **cannot** be a `route.js` file at the same route segment level as `page.js`.
40. 
41. ### Supported HTTP Methods
42. 
43. The following [HTTP methods](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/HTTP/Methods) are supported: `GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE`, `HEAD`, and `OPTIONS`. If an unsupported method is called, Next.js will return a `405 Method Not Allowed` response.
44. 
45. ### Extended `NextRequest` and `NextResponse` APIs
46. 
47. In addition to supporting the native [Request](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Request) and [Response](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Response) APIs, Next.js extends them with [`NextRequest`](/docs/app/api-reference/functions/next-request) and [`NextResponse`](/docs/app/api-reference/functions/next-response) to provide convenient helpers for advanced use cases.
48. 
49. ### Caching
50. 
51. Route Handlers are not cached by default. You can, however, opt into caching for `GET` methods. Other supported HTTP methods are **not** cached. To cache a `GET` method, use a [route config option](/docs/app/guides/caching-without-cache-components#dynamic) such as `export const dynamic = 'force-static'` in your Route Handler file.
52. 
53. ```ts filename="app/items/route.ts" switcher
54. export const dynamic = 'force-static'
55. 
56. export async function GET() {
57.   const res = await fetch('https://data.mongodb-api.com/...', {
58.     headers: {
59.       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
60.       'API-Key': process.env.DATA_API_KEY,
61.     },
62.   })
63.   const data = await res.json()
64. 
65.   return Response.json({ data })
66. }
67. ```
68. 
69. ```js filename="app/items/route.js" switcher
70. export const dynamic = 'force-static'
71. 
72. export async function GET() {
73.   const res = await fetch('https://data.mongodb-api.com/...', {
74.     headers: {
75.       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
76.       'API-Key': process.env.DATA_API_KEY,
77.     },
78.   })
79.   const data = await res.json()
80. 
81.   return Response.json({ data })
82. }
83. ```
84. 
85. > **Good to know**: Other supported HTTP methods are **not** cached, even if they are placed alongside a `GET` method that is cached, in the same file.
86. 
87. #### With Cache Components
88. 
89. When [Cache Components](/docs/app/getting-started/caching) is enabled, `GET` Route Handlers follow the same model as normal UI routes in your application. They run at request time by default, can be prerendered when they don't access uncached or runtime data, and you can use `use cache` to include uncached data in the static response.
90. 
91. **Static example** - doesn't access uncached or runtime data, so it will be prerendered at build time:
92. 
93. ```tsx filename="app/api/project-info/route.ts"
94. export async function GET() {
95.   return Response.json({
96.     projectName: 'Next.js',
97.   })
98. }
99. ```
100. 
101. **Dynamic example** - accesses non-deterministic operations. During the build, prerendering stops when `Math.random()` is called, deferring to request-time rendering:
102. 
103. ```tsx filename="app/api/random-number/route.ts"
104. export async function GET() {
105.   return Response.json({
106.     randomNumber: Math.random(),
107.   })
108. }
109. ```
110. 
111. **Runtime data example** - accesses request-specific data. Prerendering terminates when runtime APIs like `headers()` are called:
112. 
113. ```tsx filename="app/api/user-agent/route.ts"
114. import { headers } from 'next/headers'
115. 
116. export async function GET() {
117.   const headersList = await headers()
118.   const userAgent = headersList.get('user-agent')
119. 
120.   return Response.json({ userAgent })
121. }
122. ```
123. 
124. > **Good to know**: Prerendering stops if the `GET` handler accesses network requests, database queries, async file system operations, request object properties (like `req.url`, `request.headers`, `request.cookies`, `request.body`), runtime APIs like [`cookies()`](/docs/app/api-reference/functions/cookies), [`headers()`](/docs/app/api-reference/functions/headers), [`connection()`](/docs/app/api-reference/functions/connection), or non-deterministic operations.
125. 
126. **Cached example** - accesses uncached data (database query) but caches it with `use cache`, allowing it to be included in the prerendered response:
127. 
128. ```tsx filename="app/api/products/route.ts"
129. import { cacheLife } from 'next/cache'
130. 
131. export async function GET() {
132.   const products = await getProducts()
133.   return Response.json(products)
134. }
135. 
136. async function getProducts() {
137.   'use cache'
138.   cacheLife('hours')
139. 
140.   return await db.query('SELECT * FROM products')
````

### Copilot

Done — I pushed the core fixes for the exact regressions you called out:

1. **No more Server Action map-click mutations (hard-reload trigger removed):** map add/remove now goes through `fetch` to a new Route Handler (`/api/areas/[areaId]/layers/[layerId]/postal-codes`) instead of `next-action` calls from map clicks.
2. **Right-click now pans without rotate:** I kept rotate disabled and added explicit right-drag pan handling so RMB drag moves the map instead of rotating or opening the menu.
3. **Hover/move FPS improved over postal codes:** I removed deck auto-highlight churn and optimized hover tooltip updates so layer membership lookup is memoized and tooltip DOM rebuilds are skipped when hover target data hasn’t changed.

Changed in:
- `src/components/postal-codes/postal-codes-view-client-layers.tsx`
- `src/app/api/areas/[areaId]/layers/[layerId]/postal-codes/route.ts`
- `src/components/shared/base-map.tsx`
- `src/lib/hooks/use-deck-layers.ts`

306.           },

356.       });
357.     }
358.   });

360.   return {
361.     optimisticLayers,
362.     optimisticLayersRef,
363.     optimisticUndoRedo,
364.     addPostalCodesToLayer,
365.     removePostalCodesFromLayer,
